title: William Dault Buried
text:
William Dault Buried

SAVOY.—Graveside service was held Tuesday at 2:30 p.m. in Sunnyside Cemetery, near Savoy, for William F. Dault, 93, who died in his home here Monday at 1:40 p.m. after a two-year illness. He was a native of Tennessee.

W. H. Secoy, minister of the Savoy Church of Christ, officiated. Arrangements were in charge of Earnheart Funeral Home.

Survivors are one son, Preston Dault of Fort Worth; two daughters, Mrs. Helen Bennett of St. Louis, Mo., and Mrs. Hazel Miller of Savoy; one sister, Mrs. Maggie Hale of Palacios.
